Requires the real LLM loop (decide/stub.js has no search_help rule), so this fixture is NOT in check.sh's REQUIRED_STUB_FIXTURES list. cta.kind isn't checked by replay.js's matcher (action+target only) — eyeball the trace/action log during a live run to confirm it.
